# AURA EDGE — Phase 1 CPU vs GPU Voice Benchmarks

**Date:** 2026-11-25  
**Hardware:** Intel Core i7-13650HX (14P/20L cores), `15.78 GB` RAM, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB Laptop GPU (`6144 MiB` VRAM, Driver `621.24`), Windows 11.  
**Source Dataset:** `models/eval_audio/phase1_benchmarks.json` (generated by `backend/scripts/benchmark_phase1.py --trials 3`).  
**Note on Methodology:** All numbers below were measured directly on this machine with `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`, `strict_offline` network policy, `faster-whisper-small` (`en`/`hi`), `indic-conformer-kn` (`kn`), `sherpa-onnx 1.13.8` (`num_threads=8`), and `qwen3.5:4b` (`num_ctx=4096`). Cold runs measure the first uncached request (including model/cache initialization); warm metrics summarize 3 sequential warm trials.

---

## 1. Effective Hardware Placement

| Component | `cpu` Mode (`effective_mode="cpu"`) | `gpu` Mode (`effective_mode="gpu"`) | `auto` Mode |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Faster-Whisper `small` (`en`/`hi`)** | `cpu` (`int8`) | `cuda` (`int8_float16`) via retained `torch\lib` DLL handle | `cuda` when probe passes, else CPU `int8` with recorded `fallback_reason` |
| **IndicConformer CTC (`kn` specialist)** | `cpu` (`int8`, `num_threads=4`) | `cpu` (`int8`, lightweight ONNX keeps VRAM free) | `cpu` (`int8`) |
| **Silero VAD v5 ONNX** | `cpu` | `cpu` (pinned to CPU to save VRAM) | `cpu` |
| **TTSRouter (`sherpa-onnx` Piper/MMS)** | `cpu` (`num_threads=8`) | `cpu` (pinned to CPU to avoid GPU context contention) | `cpu` |
| **Ollama `qwen3.5:4b` Fallback** | `cpu` (`num_gpu=0` explicitly passed) | `gpu` (`num_gpu=null`, GPU offload enabled) | `gpu` if CUDA available, else `cpu` |
| **Measured Process RSS After Run** | `1442.6 MB` | `1587.0 MB` | Mode-dependent |
| **Measured System VRAM Used** | `1919 MiB` / `6144 MiB` | `2367 MiB` / `6144 MiB` | Mode-dependent |

## 2. Tier-0 Deterministic Routing & Local Tool Latency (96 Utterances)

Measured across all `96` multilingual utterances (`32 en`, `32 hi`, `32 kn`) against live PostgreSQL `16.16`:

| Metric | Measured Result |
|---|---|
| **Deterministic Router Median Latency** | `0.41 ms` |
| **Deterministic Router p95 Latency** | `1.49 ms` |
| **Local Tool Execution Median Latency** (`DateTimeTool` / `TimerManager` + DB) | `0.04 ms` |
| **Local Tool Execution p95 Latency** (`INSERT`/`UPDATE` PostgreSQL timers) | `8.64 ms` |
| **Multilingual Intent Accuracy (EN / HI / KN)** | `100.0%` (`96 / 96`: EN `32/32`, HI `32/32`, KN `32/32`) |
| **Verified Action Success Rate** | `100.0%` |
| **Incorrect Action Rate (Unsupported / Refusal Guard)** | `0.0%` |

## 3. Speech Pipeline End-to-End Comparison: CPU vs GPU

End-to-end (`E2E`) benchmark measures recorded WAV audio (`phase1a_tts_{en,hi,kn}.wav`) -> STT -> Tier-0 Router -> Tool execution -> uncached TTS synthesis (`time to synthesized WAV / audible response ready`).

### English (`en` — `faster-whisper-small` + Piper `en_US-lessac-medium`)

| Stage | CPU Cold | CPU Warm Median | CPU Warm p95 | GPU Cold | GPU Warm Median | GPU Warm p95 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **STT Latency** | `2577.66 ms` | `2686.00 ms` | `2708.38 ms` | `1521.88 ms` | `260.81 ms` | `273.81 ms` |
| **TTS Latency (uncached)** | `342.48 ms` | `298.81 ms` | — | `571.41 ms` | `316.24 ms` | — |
| **End-to-End Turn** | `5337.52 ms` | `3003.62 ms` | `3025.49 ms` | `4215.85 ms` | `616.13 ms` | `627.49 ms` |

### Hindi (`hi` — `faster-whisper-small` + Piper `hi_IN-rohan-medium`)

| Stage | CPU Cold | CPU Warm Median | CPU Warm p95 | GPU Cold | GPU Warm Median | GPU Warm p95 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **STT Latency** | `3411.39 ms` | `3398.28 ms` | `3420.41 ms` | `668.10 ms` | `641.29 ms` | `680.08 ms` |
| **TTS Latency (uncached)** | `229.45 ms` | `198.62 ms` | — | `373.14 ms` | `212.47 ms` | — |
| **End-to-End Turn** | `4693.67 ms` | `3602.85 ms` | `3644.49 ms` | `1050.63 ms` | `848.89 ms` | `899.11 ms` |

### Kannada (`kn` — `indic-conformer-kn` CPU INT8 + MMS-TTS `vits-mms-kan`)

| Stage | Baseline (`whisper-small`) CPU / GPU Warm | Upgraded (`indic-conformer-kn`) CPU Bench Cold / Warm | Upgraded GPU Bench Cold / Warm | Live Conversation HTTP STT Range |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **STT Latency** | `20401.98 ms` / `3680.22 ms` | `341.67 ms` / `637.35 ms` (`653.79 ms` p95) | `342.98 ms` / `671.25 ms` (`702.64 ms` p95) | `170.58–420.57 ms` (`57.3–93.1 ms` isolated) |
| **TTS Latency (uncached)** | `1801.67 ms` / `1346.12 ms` | `1511.34 ms` / `1804.72 ms` | `1804.73 ms` / `1580.45 ms` | `949.95–1344.49 ms` short/medium reply |
| **End-to-End Turn** | `21839.40 ms` / `5015.23 ms` | `3863.92 ms` / `2476.37 ms` (`2580.77 ms` p95) | `3178.83 ms` / `2283.56 ms` (`2312.11 ms` p95) | Validated `5/5` multi-turn pass |

*Note: With `TTSRouter` LRU caching enabled, repeated status/error phrases serve cached WAV bytes in `<1 ms`.*

## 4. Local LLM Fallback Comparison (`qwen3.5:4b`)

| Metric | CPU (`num_gpu=0`) | GPU (RTX 3050 6GB) — Co-resident w/ Whisper `small` | GPU (Phase 1A Isolated) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Cold Call** | `9562.46 ms` | `1887.52 ms` | `6746.73 ms` |
| **Warm Call** | `1860.35 ms` | `1710.81 ms` | `861.19 ms` |
| **TTFT** | `508.61 ms` | `458.35 ms` | `280.66 ms` |
| **Throughput** | `10.37 tok/s` | `11.20 tok/s` | `41.43 tok/s` |

**Takeaway:** GPU placement speeds up warm English STT by **`10.3×`** (`2686 ms -> 260 ms`) and Hindi STT by **`5.3×`** (`3398 ms -> 641 ms`), keeping GPU end-to-end English/Hindi turns around **`0.6s`–`0.85s`**. Replacing Whisper with CPU INT8 `indic-conformer-kn` for Kannada cuts warm CPU E2E latency by **`8.8×`** (`21.8s -> 2.48s`) and raises spoken Kannada routing from unworkable gibberish to **`5/5`** verified turns.
